The SVF740T is an N-channel enhancement-mode power MOSFET produced by Hangzhou Silan Microelectronics, housed in a standard TO-220-3L package.

Key Specifications

• Type: N-Channel Power MOSFET (TO-220)
• Drain-Source Voltage (\(V_{DS}\)): 400 V
• Gate-Source Voltage (\(V_{GS}\)): ± 30 V
• Continuous Drain Current (\(I_{D}\)): 10 A (at \(T_C = 25^\circ\text{C}\))
• Total Power Dissipation (\(P_{D}\)): 130 W
• Drain-Source On-Resistance (\(R_{DS(on)}\)): 0.45 Ω typical (0.60 Ω max at \(V_{GS} = 10\text{V}\), \(I_D = 5.0\text{A}\))
• Gate Threshold Voltage (\(V_{GS(th)}\)): 2.0 V to 4.0 V
• Operating & Storage Temperature (\(T_J, T_{stg}\)): -55°C to +150°C

Common Applications

• AC-DC power supplies
• DC-DC converters
• H-bridge PWM motor drivers
